en_title: GTA 6 Devs Are Still Worried About Layoffs, Despite Making One of the Most Successful Games Ever Made
cn_title: 尽管打造出有史以来最成功的游戏之一，《GTA6》开发者仍担心裁员
opus_summary: 尽管《GTA6》获得好评并打破Twitch直播纪录，一些Rockstar开发者仍担心裁员。动画程序员Nestor Uriarte表示，目前没有迹象表明裁员即将发生；他还称团队担忧人工智能在行业中的作用。Rockstar的工会承认投票将持续至11月26日。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is already an incredibly successful game, and when the dust settles, it'll likely end up as one of the most lucrative entertainment releases of all time. Yet some of the developers are still worried that layoffs are lurking around the corner.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》已经是一款极其成功的游戏，等到尘埃落定，它很可能会成为有史以来最赚钱的娱乐作品之一。然而，一些开发者仍然担心裁员即将到来。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is already tied for the best-reviewed game of all time with the original Ocarina of Time, and it's already broken streaming records on Twitch . It'll be a while yet before we get any kind of precise data on how well the game sold, but going off of preorder info , it's going to rake in a ton of money. Despite all of that, Rockstar devs are still worried that layoffs could put a damper on their celebrations.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》已经与初代《Ocarina of Time》并列成为有史以来评价最高的游戏，还打破了Twitch上的直播纪录。我们还需要等待一段时间才能获得有关游戏销量的任何准确数据，但从预售信息来看，它将赚得盆满钵满。尽管如此，Rockstar开发者仍然担心裁员可能会给他们的庆祝蒙上阴影。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Animation Programmer Nestor Uriarte wrote an opinion piece for The Guardian ahead of the Rockstar union recognition vote. He spent a lot of his time in his op-ed making the case for unionization in the games industry, at one point pointing out, "While the highs of a game release like this can be incredible, game workers have also come to expect other, less welcome side effects: intense overtime in the buildup and mass redundancies in the aftermath."
paragraphs.cn: 在Rockstar工会承认投票之前，Rockstar动画程序员Nestor Uriarte为卫报撰写了一篇评论文章。他在文章中花了大量篇幅论述游戏行业组建工会的理由，并指出：「虽然这样一款游戏发行时带来的喜悦可能令人难以置信，但游戏从业者也已经预料到其他不那么受欢迎的附带影响：发行前的高强度加班和发行后的大规模裁员。」

paragraphs.en: Uriarte acknowledges that there isn't any indication that layoffs are actually coming, but it's not hard to see why Rockstar devs would be nervous now that the game is out. 2026 has been littered with layoffs. Just today, Ubisoft cut 166 jobs from its Montreal and Quebec offices . Xbox, too, has been notorious for job cuts this year , as CEO Asha Sharma attempts to "reset" the company . Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has even cheered on these job cuts , saying they're "great to see."
paragraphs.cn: Uriarte承认，没有任何迹象表明裁员真的即将到来，但游戏现已推出，不难理解Rockstar开发者为何会感到紧张。2026年裁员事件频发。就在今天，育碧在其蒙特利尔和魁北克办公室裁撤了166个职位。XBOX今年也因裁员而声名狼藉，其CEO Asha Sharma正试图「重置」公司。微软CEO Satya Nadella甚至为这些裁员叫好，称其「令人欣喜」。

paragraphs.en: In his piece, Uriarte also says the Rockstar team is worried about the role that AI will play in the industry going forward. Back in March, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick laughed off the notion that someone could create a game at the same scale and quality as GTA 6 with a simple prompt, but he did acknowledge in that same interview that some AI tools are still helpful for game creation.
paragraphs.cn: Uriarte还在文章中表示，Rockstar团队担心AI今后将在行业中扮演的角色。早在3月，Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick对有人能用一条简单的提示词制作出规模和质量与《GTA6》相当的游戏这一说法一笑置之，但他在同一次采访中也承认，一些AI工具对游戏创作仍有帮助。

paragraphs.en: For their part, Rockstar developers want protection from being replaced from those kinds of tools. According to Uriarte's piece, "Across the [gaming] sector, the skills that workers spend years developing risk being devalued as their creative work is replaced by AI. Rockstar has said it is committed to preserving jobs and it has been clear that our games will continue to be made by people. But with recognition we’d have a seat at the table to manage this industry-wide transition together."
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar开发者则希望获得保障，避免被这类工具取代。Uriarte在文章中写道：「在整个游戏行业，随着从业者的创意工作被AI取代，他们花费多年培养的技能面临贬值的风险。Rockstar表示致力于保住工作岗位，也明确表示我们的游戏将继续由人制作。但获得承认后，我们就能在谈判桌上占有一席之地，共同应对这场席卷整个行业的转变。」

paragraphs.en: The vote for recognition of the IWGB union at Rockstar is currently underway and runs until November 26. If it's successful, would end up being the biggest recognized union in U.K. games history. The unionization effort has been contentious, too, after Rockstar fired dozens of staff members, leading to accusations of union busting .
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar关于承认IWGB工会的投票目前正在进行，将持续至11月26日。如果投票成功，该工会将成为英国游戏史上获得承认的最大工会。组建工会的努力也引发了争议，Rockstar解雇了数十名员工，因此遭到破坏工会的指控。
